entity_types.name: Organization
entity_types.description: Corporate actors: miners, smelters, traders, consultancies driving copper supply decisions

attributes.name: sector
attributes.description: Industry segment: mining, smelting, trading, consulting

attributes.name: influence_tier
attributes.description: High/medium/low influence on end-2027 copper price

entity_types.selection_rule: Any named firm whose production, guidance, benchmark negotiation or trading decisions causally move copper supply or price

entity_types.name: Government
entity_types.description: National governments and state bodies with policy levers over mines, tariffs and stockpiles

attributes.name: policy_lever
attributes.description: Main lever: mine approval, tariff setting, stockpiling, capacity policy

entity_types.selection_rule: Sovereign state bodies whose approvals, tariffs or reserve operations causally affect copper supply/price
anti_examples: ICSG (intergovernmental data body, model as InternationalBody)

entity_types.name: SmelterGroup
entity_types.description: Smelter coalitions and refined-copper producers holding the concentrate constraint

attributes.name: cut_compliance
attributes.description: Compliance with pledged output cuts: high/partial/none

entity_types.selection_rule: Coalitions of smelters coordinating output or benchmark negotiation, not individual firms (those are Organization)
anti_examples: Jiangxi Copper as a single company

entity_types.name: MineProject
entity_types.description: Named mines and ramp projects contributing dated kt/yr supply increments

attributes.name: capacity_kt_yr
attributes.description: Nameplate or guided capacity in kt/yr

entity_types.selection_rule: Specific named mine sites/projects whose increments are cited in kt/yr supply forecasts

entity_types.name: ExchangeMarket
entity_types.description: Metals exchanges where copper prices, stocks and spreads are formed

attributes.name: contract_role
attributes.description: Price-discovery role: global benchmark or dislocated tariff market

entity_types.selection_rule: Trading venues whose settlements, stocks or spreads define the forecast statistic
anti_examples: SMM index (a signal, not a venue)

entity_types.name: TradePolicyInstrument
entity_types.description: Tariff and trade-policy instruments shaping copper flows and the COMEX-LME arb
entity_types.selection_rule: Concrete legal instruments with dates/rates that dislocate copper trade flows

entity_types.name: MarketIndicator
entity_types.description: Trackable price/stock/TC indicators used as forecast signposts
entity_types.selection_rule: Named quantitative series with defined thresholds discriminating scenarios

entity_types.name: ForecastingSource
entity_types.description: Banks, consultancies and data agencies publishing forecasts and data used as reference class
entity_types.selection_rule: Entities publishing price/balance forecasts or market data that anchor expectations; passive information sources

edge_types.name: REGULATES
edge_types.description: Government regulates, approves or taxes an organization, project or policy instrument
edge_types.direction_semantics: Source government holds approval/tax authority over target firm, project or venue

edge_types.name: OPERATES
edge_types.description: An organization owns or operates a mine project
edge_types.direction_semantics: Source company operates target mine/project and controls its output decisions

edge_types.name: SUPPLIES
edge_types.description: Mine projects or smelter groups supply concentrate/refined copper to the market chain
edge_types.direction_semantics: Source supplies concentrate or refined metal to target

edge_types.name: NEGOTIATES_BENCHMARK_WITH
edge_types.description: Annual TC/RC benchmark negotiation between miners and smelters
edge_types.direction_semantics: Source and target are counterparties in the annual TC/RC settlement

edge_types.name: DEPENDS_ON
edge_types.description: Smelter refined output depends on concentrate supply from mines/projects
edge_types.direction_semantics: Source's output/flows are constrained by target's availability

edge_types.name: CONSTRAINS
edge_types.description: Policy instruments or concentrate scarcity constrain market outcomes
edge_types.direction_semantics: Source restricts or caps target's flows/output, transmitting to price

edge_types.name: CAUSES
edge_types.description: Causal transmission from indicators/policies to the price statistic
edge_types.direction_semantics: Source change causes target indicator/price movement

edge_types.name: INFLUENCES
edge_types.description: Actors or sources influence market expectations and price formation
edge_types.direction_semantics: Source shapes expectations or flows at target market/indicator

edge_types.name: PUBLISHES
edge_types.description: Forecasting sources publish indicators and forecasts
edge_types.direction_semantics: Source publishes/assesses target indicator or forecast

edge_types.name: STOCKPILES_AT
edge_types.description: State stockpiling bodies accumulate or release metal via warehouses/markets
edge_types.direction_semantics: Source stockpiler buys into or releases from target market/supplier

analysis_summary: 该预测问题为LME铜现金结算价（2027-12-31，P10/P50/P90），核心机制是精矿短缺驱动的挤压与中国冶炼产能、矿山增量、美国232关税与库存分布之间的博弈。角色阵容以企业（矿商/冶炼厂）与政府（中国、巴拿马、美国）为主，因此保留Organization与Government，并增设SmelterGroup（CSPT等协调集团）、MineProject（可量化的kt/yr增量客体）、ExchangeMarket（LME/COMEX）、TradePolicyInstrument（232/Annex III）、MarketIndicator（TC/RC、库存、价差等信号）、ForecastingSource（银行/ICSG/CRU等被动信息源，tier 3）。边覆盖监管、运营、供应、基准谈判、依赖、约束、因果传导、影响、发布与收储十类，其中CONSTRAINS/CAUSES携带sign/lag/strength属性以刻画冲击向结算价的传导路径，服务多智能体推演。
